mapping.ownership: successful obstacle_t** results are caller-owned and adopted by c_obstacle
mapping.status: every non-OK navsys_status_t is raised through raise_for_status
mapping.seed: generate_random_rect requires an explicit keyword-only uint64 seed
mapping.options: max_cells and applicable raster/fill/clip policies are exposed
